name: Shaka Packager MCP Server
description: Integrates Shaka Packager with Claude to enable video analysis, transcoding, and packaging for HLS and DASH streaming. It supports advanced features like DRM encryption and content conversion while working alongside the Filesystem MCP server to process local media files.
